definitions: A small fern, Botrychium lunaria (lesser moonwort); later, any member of the genus. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}
Lunaria annua (greater moonwort); also known as honesty and annual honesty.

blocks.text: Botrychium is a genus of ferns, seedless vascular plants in the family Ophioglossaceae. Botrychium species are known as moonworts. They are small, with fleshy roots, and reproduce by spores shed into the air. One part of the leaf, the trophophore, is sterile and fernlike; the other, the sporophore, is fertile and carries the clusters of sporangia or spore cases. Some species only occasionally emerge above ground and gain most of their nourishment from an association with mycorrhizal fungi.
